title: VKORC1 de novo ligand discovery — supplementary data (GNN, docking, REINVENT4, MD)
description: Frozen multi-task master CSV, GNN checkpoints, Murcko scaffold split JSON, VKORC1 RL_Gen docking results, comparative membrane MD summaries (RL_Gen_37_isoA, RL_Gen_29_isoA, S-warfarin reference), manuscript figures/tables, REINVENT4 scoring configuration, and reproduction scripts accompanying the warfarin-docking-project publication.
notes: Build package with: ALLOW_STALE_CHECKPOINT=1 bash publication/build_all.sh; then zip deposition/package/.
